title: Number of Valid Subarrays
summary: For an integer array, count the non-empty subarrays where the first element is not greater than any other element within the subarray.
statement: For an integer array, count the non-empty subarrays where the first element is not greater than any other element within the subarray. A subarray consists of consecutive elements from the original array.
constraints: A subarray is valid when its leftmost element is no greater than every later element.
hints: A previous start remains valid until a smaller value appears.
Keep a nondecreasing stack of active starting values.
Pop values greater than the new endpoint; after pushing it, stack size is the number of valid subarrays ending here.
Each surviving stack entry represents one start whose first value is still minimal through this endpoint.
editorial: Each surviving stack entry represents one start whose first value is still minimal through this endpoint.

tests.explanation: Eleven subarrays keep their first value as a minimum.
Only the three singleton subarrays are valid.
